title: A work pipeline you could ship
summary: Build, in three stages, the in-process job pipeline every service ends up needing: a bounded queue with backpressure and a worker pool, then graceful shutdown with a drain deadline, then per-tenant fairness and retries with backoff.

parts.label: TryEnqueueAsync
parts.note: waits a bounded time, then says no

parts.label: worker pool
parts.note: N consumers, failures counted, never fatal

parts.label: StopAsync + drain deadline
parts.note: finish what is queued, cancel what overruns

parts.label: stopping token
parts.note: stop taking work, finish the job in hand

parts.label: per-tenant limit
parts.note: one noisy tenant cannot take every worker's attention
